problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 17 infrastructure projects to maximize the total expected community benefit.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: expected benefit is 0.142, disruption index is 0.238, allocation bounds [0.011, 0.434]  
* Project B: expected benefit is 0.062, disruption index is 0.218, allocation bounds [0.099, 0.646]  
* Project C: expected benefit is 0.107, disruption index is 0.019, allocation bounds [0.003, 0.854]  
* Project D: expected benefit is 0.153, disruption index is 0.154, allocation bounds [0.093, 0.339]  
* Project E: expected benefit is 0.163, disruption index is 0.035, allocation bounds [0.033, 0.506]  
* Project F: expected benefit is 0.083, disruption index is 0.251, allocation bounds [0.038, 0.846]  
* Project G: expected benefit is 0.189, disruption index is 0.299, allocation bounds [0.028, 0.746]  
* Project H: expected benefit is 0.189, disruption index is 0.296, allocation bounds [0.072, 0.735]  
* Project I: expected benefit is 0.106, disruption index is 0.145, allocation bounds [0.067, 0.692]  
* Project J: expected benefit is 0.139, disruption index is 0.270, allocation bounds [0.095, 0.771]  
* Project K: expected benefit is 0.146, disruption index is 0.287, allocation bounds [0.067, 0.880]  
* Project L: expected benefit is 0.038, disruption index is 0.150, allocation bounds [0.067, 0.562]  
* Project M: expected benefit is 0.089, disruption index is 0.167, allocation bounds [0.092, 0.440]  
* Project N: expected benefit is 0.129, disruption index is 0.081, allocation bounds [0.063, 0.455]  
* Project O: expected benefit is 0.148, disruption index is 0.059, allocation bounds [0.049, 0.475]  
* Project P: expected benefit is 0.177, disruption index is 0.284, allocation bounds [0.080, 0.367]  
* Project Q: expected benefit is 0.178, disruption index is 0.213, allocation bounds [0.033, 0.504]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified bounds, and the sum of all budget shares must equal the total available budget (normalized to 1). To prioritize critical services, the planner requires that the group of high-priority projects, represented by the subset P = {A, C, D, E, F, H, I, M}, collectively receive at least 0.413 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall disruption index of the portfolio must not exceed 0.244, and the total expected benefit must be at least 0.099.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes total expected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
